entries.title: Proverbs 6:1
segments: My son, if thou art become surety for thy neighbor, If thou hast stricken thy hands for a stranger;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:2
segments: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, Thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:3
segments: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, Seeing thou art come into the hand of thy neighbor: Go, humble thyself, and importune thy neighbor;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:4
segments: Give not sleep to thine eyes, Nor slumber to thine eyelids;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:5
segments: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand [of the hunter], And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:6
segments: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; Consider her ways, and be wise:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:7
segments: Which having no chief, Overseer, or ruler,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:8
segments: Provideth her bread in the summer, And gathereth her food in the harvest.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:9
segments: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:10
segments: [Yet] a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:11
segments: So shall thy poverty come as a robber, And thy want as an armed man.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:12
segments: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, Is he that walketh with a perverse mouth;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:13
segments: That winketh with his eyes, that speaketh with his feet, That maketh signs with his fingers;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:14
segments: In whose heart is perverseness, Who deviseth evil continually, Who soweth discord.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:15
segments: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; On a sudden shall he be broken, and that without remedy.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:16
segments: There are six things which Jehovah hateth; Yea, seven which are an abomination unto him:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:17
segments: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:18
segments: A heart that deviseth wicked purposes, Feet that are swift in running to mischief,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:19
segments: A false witness that uttereth lies, And he that soweth discord among brethren.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:20
segments: My son, keep the commandment of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:21
segments: Bind them continually upon thy heart; Tie them about thy neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:22
segments: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee; When thou sleepest, it shall watch over thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:23
segments: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; And reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:24
segments: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the flattery of the foreigner's tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:25
segments: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; Neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:26
segments: For on account of a harlot [a man is brought] to a piece of bread; And the adulteress hunteth for the precious life.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:27
segments: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:28
segments: Or can one walk upon hot coals, And his feet not be scorched?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:29
segments: So he that goeth in to his neighbor's wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not be unpunished.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:30
segments: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy himself when he is hungry:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:31
segments: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; He shall give all the substance of his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:32
segments: He that committeth adultery with a woman is void of understanding: He doeth it who would destroy his own soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:33
segments: Wounds and dishonor shall he get; And his reproach shall not be wiped away.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:34
segments: For jealousy is the rage of a man; And he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:35
segments: He will not regard any ransom; Neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
